cases.description: Task dir collision for synthetic-01: synthetic-01

actions.label: Create new (append timestamp)
actions.description: Creates a fresh task dir with a timestamp suffix and dispatches as a new production-lane root run. Use when the prior dirs are stale/abandoned and you just want to retry from scratch — does not link to existing runs.

actions.label: Start comparison lane
actions.description: Files this run as a comparison-lane sibling of the existing family (same ticket, same family ID, new variant tag). Use when you want to A/B compare runner/model/template changes against a prior run for the same bug.

actions.label: Abort run
actions.description: Cancels the current dispatch without touching existing task dirs. Use when the collision was unexpected and you need to investigate the prior runs before re-dispatching.
